patterns: APPSC asks direct concept/attribution items: who coined Sanskritisation (M.N. Srinivas), meaning of acculturation, which is NOT a source of social change.
Development-model items stress non-material indicators of development.
Traps: Srinivas's earlier term 'Brahminisation'; seasonal nomad migration is not social change; politics is not a lagging factor in cultural lag.
App MCQs add many theorist/book matching items (Spengler, Toynbee, diffusionist schools) at a depth above the single APPSC PYQ here.
